items.title: Risky Biz Podcast: Eliminating Vulnerabilities Without Upgrading Dependencies
items.description: Socket CEO Feross Aboukhadijeh joins Risky Business Podcast to discuss eliminating open source vulnerabilities at scale without requiring dependency upgrades.

items.title: Introducing Socket Calm: A Syntax Highlighting Theme for VS Code, Vim, and Neovim
items.description: Socket Calm is a free, open source syntax highlighting theme for VS Code, Vim, and Neovim, inspired by Socket's design system.

items.title: Socket Releases Free Patches for 100% of Critical CVEs in RubyGems
items.description: Fix critical RubyGems vulnerabilities without upgrading dependencies. Free security patches are now available with more ways to install and deploy them.

items.title: 13 Malicious NuGet Packages Target .NET Developers With Fake Job Assessments
items.description: Socket researchers uncovered 13 malicious NuGet packages linked to fake developer job assessments, DLL side-loading, credential theft, and GitHub-based malware.

items.title: Hardening GitHub Actions Against Insider Threats
items.description: A practical guide to securing CI/CD pipelines against stolen credentials, covering GitHub Actions, trusted publishing, release approvals, and revocation.

items.title: MITRE Acknowledges Inaccurate Publication Timestamps in 87% of Its Recent CVE Records
items.description: MITRE acknowledges inaccurate publication timestamps in 87% of its recent CVE records and plans to retire the legacy system responsible in 2027.

items.title: Optimizely Supply Chain Attack Distributes Malware Across Global Brands
items.description: Attackers exploited Optimizely to inject malicious JavaScript into major websites, delivering cryptocurrency clippers, card skimmers, and iOS malware.

items.title: Microsoft’s agent-framework PyPI package Compromised with Credential Stealer
items.description: Compromised agent-framework versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 on PyPI use .pth startup hooks to exfiltrate Azure, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD credentials.

items.title: pnpm Introduces New Lockfile Format to Reduce Git Merge Conflicts
items.description: pnpm has introduced an experimental lockfile format designed to reduce Git merge conflicts by changing how dependencies are recorded.

items.title: ESLint Ends Paid Contributor Program as AI Upends Open Source Collaboration
items.description: From Rust to Godot and curl, open source projects are tightening contribution rules as AI-generated code strains maintainers and changes how developers collaborate.
